title: Add checkout with address collection and order management

requirements.summary: Create checkout page with cart summary, contact info inputs, and order placement button
acceptanceCriteria: Page displays complete cart items with quantities and prices
Page includes text input field for phone number with appropriate validation
Page includes textarea for delivery address
Page displays calculated order total in ₹ format
Page includes 'Place Order' button that submits the order
Page maintains Swapan Store design theme with warm Indian spice market colors

file_operations.description: Create checkout page component that displays cart summary with product names, quantities, and prices, input fields for phone number (with validation) and delivery address (textarea), calculates and displays order total using formatPrice utility, and includes a 'Place Order' button. Use existing Swapan Store warm color theme with earthy tones. Display cart items with images mapped from local generated assets using the same pattern as ProductsPage.tsx.

requirements.summary: Implement checkout flow with backend order creation, cart clearing, and delivery confirmation message
acceptanceCriteria: Place Order button triggers backend order creation with phone and address
Success response displays confirmation message 'Your order will be delivered today!'
Cart is emptied after successful order placement
User receives visual feedback (toast or modal) with the delivery confirmation
Error states are handled with appropriate user feedback

file_operations.description: Add form submission handler that validates phone number and address inputs, calls the placeOrder mutation hook with form data, displays success toast with message 'Your order will be delivered today!' on successful order creation, and handles error states with appropriate user feedback using toast notifications. Navigate to products page after successful order placement.

requirements.summary: Add 'Proceed to Checkout' button to cart page that navigates to checkout route
acceptanceCriteria: Button appears on cart page below cart items and total
Button is only enabled when cart contains at least one item
Button navigates to /checkout route when clicked
Button styling matches existing Swapan Store theme

file_operations.description: Add 'Proceed to Checkout' button below the cart total section that navigates to /checkout route using TanStack Router Link component. Button should be disabled when cart is empty (cartItems.length === 0) and styled to match existing Swapan Store theme with warm earthy colors. Position button prominently after total price display.

requirements.summary: Add Orders section to admin dashboard displaying all customer orders in a table
acceptanceCriteria: Orders section appears on admin dashboard page
Table displays order timestamp in readable format
Table shows customer phone number for each order
Table shows full delivery address for each order
Table lists all items with quantities for each order
Table displays total order price in ₹ format
Table is styled consistently with existing admin dashboard design
Orders are sorted by most recent first

file_operations.description: Add Orders section below the existing products table. Create a table displaying all orders fetched via the useOrders hook. Include columns for order timestamp (formatted as readable date/time), customer phone number, delivery address, items ordered (display as comma-separated list with product names and quantities), and total price in ₹ format using formatPrice utility. Sort orders by timestamp descending (most recent first). Style table consistently with existing product table design using similar card and table structure.

requirements.summary: Create React Query hook for placing orders with cart invalidation on success
acceptanceCriteria: Hook uses useMutation from React Query
Mutation calls backend order creation function with phone and address parameters
Successful mutation invalidates cart query to reflect empty cart
Hook provides loading, error, and success states to consuming components

file_operations.description: Add usePlaceOrder mutation hook that calls actor.createOrder with phone number, address, and cart items. Use useMutation from @tanstack/react-query. On successful mutation, invalidate the 'cart' query key to trigger cart refetch and reflect empty cart state. Hook should provide isLoading, isError, isSuccess states and error object to consuming components. Include useCartQuery call to get current cart items for passing to createOrder.

requirements.summary: Create React Query hook for fetching all orders in admin dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Hook uses useQuery from React Query
Hook calls backend function to retrieve all orders
Hook provides loading, error, and data states
Query is enabled only when user is authenticated as admin

file_operations.description: Add useOrders query hook that calls actor.getAllOrders backend method. Use useQuery from @tanstack/react-query with query key ['orders']. Enable query only when admin is authenticated by checking useAdminAuth().isAuthenticated. Hook should return data (array of Order objects), isLoading, and isError states for consuming components.

requirements.summary: Wire checkout page into app router configuration

file_operations.description: Add /checkout route to the TanStack Router configuration that renders the CheckoutPage component. Position route after the /cart route in the routes array. Import CheckoutPage at the top of the file.
